- [FACT] The user has been overspending on online shopping lately, especially on weekends.
- [PREFERENCE] The user is looking for ways to track expenses and stay within a budget.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested using cashback credit cards or signing up for rewards programs to earn money back on purchases.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended unsubscribing from promotional emails and blocking shopping websites or apps during weekends or specific times of the day.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant emphasized that breaking the habit of overspending takes time and discipline.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips to avoid targeted ads, including opting out of personalized ads on Facebook and Instagram.
